description:
## [0.2.1](https://github.com/pigfoot/morphe-patches/compare/v0.2.0...v0.2.1) (2026-10-25)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **camscanner:** offer qualified targets without experimental opt-in ([#3](https://github.com/pigfoot/morphe-patches/issues/3)) ([9153280](https://github.com/pigfoot/morphe-patches/commit/9153280915d03e74eaa06707ec454bc2bada398b))

patches.name: CamScanner disable ads
patches.description: Suppress qualified ad entry points with reviewed manifest cleanup. Rewarded videos are blocked by default; an explicit 7.27.0-only lottery skip experiment can forward the original task/code flow without video. Server grants are not guaranteed or overridden.

options.description: Block by default. The lottery-only skip experiment requires online 7.27.0; it preserves actual server results, not guaranteed rewards. Includes scoped initialization recovery without diagnostics or extra quota queries.

patches.name: CamScanner local premium features
patches.description: Experimental local account-status features. Does not unlock server credits or cloud quotas.

patches.name: CamScanner offline mode
patches.description: Revoke all app INTERNET declarations. Includes ad suppression; preserves real platform connectivity. External apps/services and offline error flows require device testing.

patches.name: CamScanner reduce telemetry and app logging
patches.description: Suppress qualified Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics/Performance/Sessions and app network/cache/local logging. Preserve unrelated Firebase services. Not a guarantee of zero telemetry.

patches.name: CamScanner restore trust on re-signed builds
patches.description: Required compatibility for supported re-signed standard/Shizuku installs: preserve original request signing and recover exact obsolete/error-only API Center caches. No diagnostic overlays. No forced host, global signature spoofing, authentication-result changes or INTERNET grant. Root mount is not qualified.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Optional parallel installation with a default or custom package name. Without this patch the original package is retained. The app name is unchanged; providers, permissions and links are isolated when selected.

options.description: Used only when this patch is selected. Keep the default to update an existing .morphe install with the same signing key. The app name is unchanged.

patches.name: RailsGo bus update without video
patches.description: Complete the observed bus-update rewarded unit using its loaded reward metadata; retain the original fallback. Requires sideload startup compatibility, not package renaming.

patches.name: RailsGo sideload startup compatibility
patches.description: Required for supported re-signed standard or Shizuku installs, with or without package renaming. Bypasses the Java Play-license startup entry. Root mount is not qualified.
